metadata.Record type: Fixed historical case
metadata.Description: CD8 high, CD4 low. KLRG1 low points to U49 and KLRG1 high to U67.
metadata.Statistical unit: Donors within each source, with one fixed target pair.
metadata.Limitations: Historical same-name case. Under the fair renaming used here U67 is named CD8 high, CD244 high, outside the original exact two-label group.
metadata.Same-budget fixed-description reference: The same three-antibody descriptions independently search all 128 PCA coordinates in Oxford. Low and high descriptions select their own targets. Indices are not aligned to the released model.

metadata.Record type: Targets selected within each coordinate system
metadata.Target: All same-name pairs independently named and third-antibody locked in Oxford within each coordinate system.
metadata.Statistical unit: Calculate the fraction among evaluable same-name pairs within each donor, then take the median across donors.
metadata.Limitations: Each coordinate system uses its own target indices. The endpoint retrieves coordinate activity within that model.
metadata.Denominator definition: Conditional fractions use each donor's evaluable same-name pairs. The primary fixed-opportunity endpoint uses all 8,128 pairs. These differ from donor success rates for fixed U49/U67.
metadata.Direction: Use the prespecified correct high side, without selecting the better of high and low sides.
metadata.Fixed-anchor reference: The row also records the three donor success levels and ranks for released-model U49/U67 and independently selected PCA ranks. Conditional fractions use each basis's own same-name pairs.

metadata.Record type: Marginal value of the third antibody
metadata.Cohort identity: JDM cases and controls, a previously available source.
metadata.Unit targets: Mutually exclusive high-activity U49/U67 cells, averaging net purity across both sides.
metadata.Candidate cell pool: Original frozen RNA T-gated candidate pool
metadata.Sampling quota: Fixed 10% quota per side from the same candidate pool. Boundary ties are allocated proportionally.
metadata.Fitting method: L2 logistic regression fitted in Oxford development donors. No external refitting.
metadata.Same-budget conventional panel: Conventional selection uses the same three antibodies, fitted to the same unit targets with the same method.
metadata.Conventional subtype reference: The same three antibodies trained on conventional subtypes, with different targets.
metadata.Statistical unit: For each donor subtract two-antibody from three-antibody purity, then take the median paired difference. This is not the difference between purity medians.
metadata.Donor overlap: All five sources had prior study-level exposure. Overlap of anonymous individuals across studies is unknown.
metadata.Scope: Endpoint: simulated sampling purity in existing data.
